cells.gaps: No body is named to check where the data are kept or to grant exemptions; no organisation is named as ordered, penalised or exempted under the order.
cells.note: A ministerial order of 27 August 2025 requires Starlink to host its users' connection logs, IP addresses and traffic data in Chad, a rule in force on a named kind of data, so stage 3. The minister issued it and no regulator is named to enforce it, so not stage 4.
